text:
Platinum Price in 1990
Among 9 monthly observations available for 1990, the LBMA platinum price fell 12.1% between 1990-04-30 ($469) and 1990-12-28 ($412). The highest sampled price was $490 in May and the lowest was $412 in December. The mean of these observations was $458. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
